summary: F22: deploy/fail2ban-sshd.local — minimal SSH jail config (vps-bootstrap installs fail2ban but no jail shipped, §7.4)

resolution.note: Obsolete — port 22 is firewalled to the tailscale0 interface only (vps-bootstrap.sh:166). No public SSH auth attempts can reach sshd, so a fail2ban SSH jail has nothing to watch. The fail2ban package is still installed (vps-bootstrap.sh:100) but unused; trimming it is a separate cleanup.
